title: Bound on placed vertices
statement: Let a sequential circuit have $n$ inputs, and let its combinational circuit have $r$ register sources and $g$ gates. For every natural number $k$, if $a<n+r+g$, then the vertex obtained by placing $a$ at stage $k$ is less than $n+(k+1)(r+g)$.
hypotheses_covered: A sequential circuit with $n$ inputs and $r$ registers
A natural number $a$ satisfying $a<n+r+g$, where $g$ is the number of combinational gates
